previous_statement: The two direct estimates hold with the advertised constant C_grp: ||mu(U,V)-U bold-dot V||<=C_grp*epsilon_r and ||sigma(U)-U^dagger||<=C_grp*epsilon_r.
new_statement: For the common u_delta fixed in 1.1, lem-stage1-group-closeness gives ||mu(U,V)-U bold-dot V||<=G_c*epsilon_r and ||sigma(U)-U^dagger||<=G_c*epsilon_r. Since C_grp=G>=8*G_c, each is at most C_grp*epsilon_r, including epsilon_r=0.
